scripts.speaker: Bonne
scripts.text:
Greetings!
Izlude welcomes you.

scripts.speaker: Bonne
scripts.text: Izlude is the satellite city of Prontera, capital of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom.

scripts.speaker: Bonne
scripts.text: Izlude is key to our kingdom because of the Swordsman Association located here, as well as the fact that Izlude is in charge of protecting the Rune-Midgarts coastline.

scripts.speaker: Bonne
scripts.text: I know, this bridge might look weak and fragile, but it is actually state of the art, built with the most sophisticated technology.

scripts.speaker: Bonne
scripts.text: No matter how strong storms may be, or how many people may stand on it, this bridge will NEEEEVER collapse.

scripts.speaker: Bonne
scripts.text:
Please enjoy
your visit
here in Izlude.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: Some people may think Izlude is just a satellite city of Prontera, and not really that important...

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: Though it is very beautiful, Byalan Island has a mysterious dungeon that extends deep under the sea.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: But Izlude is a beautiful town right next to the ocean, as well as beautiful Byalan Island.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: You'll have to board on a ship at the port to get to Byalan Island. There are dangerous dungeons on that island, so don't go snooping around just anywhere.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: People who've actually been there have said that if you go deep enough, the dungeon actually descends underwater.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: Surprisingly, once you're underwater, you can breathe just like a fish. Maybe some kind of supernatural force is in effect.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text:
Ah...
The people who've seen the underwater view say it is so fantastic that they've kept dreaming of it ever since.

scripts.speaker: Charfri
scripts.text: But unfortunately, the monsters are too strong for ordinary people to merely go sightseeing there. Still, just once, I'd like to go down there...

scripts.speaker: Cuskoal
scripts.text: The Arena here is THE place for capable young people from all over the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to challenge themselves and test their skills.

scripts.speaker: Cuskoal
scripts.text: The pubs in Prontera are always full of people from local areas and from out-of-town. It can get pretty busy.

scripts.speaker: Cuskoal
scripts.text: You can battle with monsters of differing levels. So, the number of stages you survive will be a testament to your battle prowess.

scripts.speaker: Cuskoal
scripts.text: So, whaddya say?

scripts.speaker: Cuskoal
scripts.text: It's a pretty good place to stop by for general information and to listen to rumors.

scripts.speaker: Cuskoal
scripts.text: So if you listen carefully, you just might get lucky and learn some very useful information for yourself.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text:
Mt. Mjornir, located north of Prontera, is a tough
and steep climb.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Some monsters in the world have the unique ability to sense mystical energy, and can detect Magic spells before they are cast.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text:
There's a very delightful place where you can find every
type of Poring.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Aside from the dangers of the mountain itself, insanely vicious insects live there too. I mean, they'll just attack you for no reason.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: If you ever want to visit somewhere past Mt. Mjolnir, then you prepare yourself for the challenge.  Or you could walk around it.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Golem of the desert is one of them. Don't underestimate it due to its sluggishness...

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: If you try to cast magic near it, it will notice and saunter over to smash you. So you better watch out for Golem.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: It's somewhere near the bridge connecting the forest and the desert, on the way to the city of Payon which is Southeast from here.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: There are not only pink Porings but also Drops, which can be found at the desert, and the green Poporing.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: But be careful, before you realize it, you may come face to face with Ghostring, a deadly Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Well, of course, they are all very cute, but Ghostring is an EXCEPTION. It is very very dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: If you are lucky enough, you might even bump into Angeling, the Poring with Angel wings.
Ghostring?
Angeling?
End Conversation.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Ghostring is a grayish Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost. Just like other ghosts, physical attacks can't do any damage to it.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Those whose main attack methods are physical like Swordman and Archer might have to run for their lives when facing Ghostrings.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: But don't leave just yet~! There is great news for people with those jobs. Making a weapon of some elemental property is the key.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: This way, even a Swordman or an Archer can inflict damage, the way Magic does, on Ghostrings.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text:
Angelings are immune to Magic attacks. If people who can only attack with Magic face an Angeling, then it's time for
them to run.

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: If you've got an extra knife or sword, you could give it a shot. But it will be very difficult alone, don't you think?

scripts.speaker: Dega
scripts.text: Good Luck~

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text: I was thinking, even though the people of Izlude live so close to the ocean...

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text: There are other cultures that have completely developed by living off of the sea. Of course, I'm talking about Amatsu.

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text: I hear the cuisine there is really good! Although the idea of eating raw fish is new to me, I would love to go there, and try it just once!

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text:
Don't you think Binoculars
are really COOL?! You can
see all sorts of places...!

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text: Here in Izlude, we are responsible for maintaining peace not only on land but also at sea. That's why this city has a huge telescope.

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text: This telescope constantly watches over the sea, so that we can prevent any serious trouble from happening. You know...

scripts.speaker: Kylick
scripts.text:
An ounce of
prevention is worth
a pound of cure
after all, right?

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text: Don't you think Strong VIT and training in a unique breathing method which enables quick HP recovery are the greatest advantages for a Swordman?

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text:
If you train your skills very hard, you can even see your HP recovering. The amount
recovered depends
vitality, or VIT.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text: So if you invest more of your stats in VIT, you'll recover more HP overall when resting.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text: But of course, it'd be good to have high Attack, wouldn't it? You can either acquire a good weapon or bring up your STR to support you Attack.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text: You know you'll need some strength anyway to swing good weapons easily, anyway.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text: Another important thing is how accurate you can hit your opponents. DEX is the key here. If you train DEX, then the gap between the MIN and MAX damage will also decrease.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text:
Hm...
Are you bored by all this talk? Or do you want me to go on?
Tell me more please.
End conversation.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text:
Hmm...
In that case, I'll explain about the other attributes to you briefly. In order to attack and evade quickly, you've gotta pay attention to AGI.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text: In case you want to make more critical hits, it's a good idea to invest in LUK. INT also increases Max SP, which is needed to use various skills... But it's really up to you.

scripts.speaker: Aaron
scripts.text:
Okay then,
train hard~~
